description: Data contract for the eToro demo trading bot. Append-only JSONL is the source of truth; the *.json files are derived snapshots, safe to regenerate. All timestamps are ISO-8601 UTC with a trailing Z. All monetary values are USD. All trade outcomes are additionally expressed in R multiples (1R = the dollar amount risked if the stop is hit), which makes trades of different sizes comparable.

account.note: The API credentials lack the trade.real:write scope, so real-money trading is structurally impossible.

events.jsonl.description: Every decision and action taken by any cycle. The audit log.

trades.jsonl.description: The learning corpus. One record per position, written at entry with the thesis tags and completed at exit with the outcome and postmortem. Records are matched on position_id; the LAST record for a position_id wins.

fields.position_id: int, eToro position id — the stable key
fields.signals: array of snake_case tags, e.g. [above_sma50, rsi_62, volume_2x]
fields.thesis: falsifiable statement of why this should work
fields.invalidation: what would prove the thesis wrong
fields.risk_r: number, USD at risk if the stop hits = 1R
fields.rules_applied: array of rule ids from strategy/rules.md
fields.outcome_r: number, realized PnL in R multiples
fields.mae_r: number, maximum adverse excursion in R (worst unrealized point)
fields.mfe_r: number, maximum favorable excursion in R (best unrealized point)
fields.lesson: one or two sentences, specific and actionable

excursions.jsonl.description: Mark-to-market sample of every open position, appended once per cycle by `etoro mark`. Feeds MAE/MFE, which is what distinguishes 'the thesis was wrong' from 'the stop was too tight'.

fields.no_trade_reason: string or null — MUST name a specific guardrail when the cycle opened nothing

equity.jsonl.description: Equity curve points for charting, one per cycle.

benchmark.jsonl.description: Reference asset prices sampled alongside the equity curve, so improvement can be separated from market drift.

fields.prices: object mapping symbol to price, e.g. {SPX500: 6100.2, NSDQ100: 22000.0, BTC: 95000.0}

stats.json.description: Computed by `etoro stats` in deterministic Python. Never hand-written, never estimated by the model. Aggregates trades.jsonl by setup, signal tag, asset class and conviction level; includes rolling 20-trade expectancy, the primary improvement metric.

portfolio.json.description: Latest account snapshot: equity, cash, open positions with live PnL.

positions.json.description: Open positions joined with their thesis fields from trades.jsonl. This is what gives a cold run memory of why each position exists.

watchlist.json.description: Ranked candidates carried between cycles, so research done in premarket feeds entries at open.

fields.candidates: array of {symbol, instrument_id, asset_class, score, setup, signals, thesis, stop, target, notes}
